name: flaggems__batch_norm_with_update_functional
description: Batch normalization in training mode that also updates running statistics (functional variant; does not mutate running_mean/running_var in place).
reference:
import torch

def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    input_shape = ctx['input__shape']
    dtype = getattr(torch, ctx['input__dtype'])
    x = torch.randn(input_shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    C = input_shape[1]
    weight = torch.randn(C, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    bias = torch.randn(C, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    running_mean = torch.zeros(C, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    running_var = torch.ones(C, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    return {
        'input': x,
        'weight': weight,
        'bias': bias,
        'running_mean': running_mean,
        'running_var': running_var,
    }

def run(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps):
    return torch.ops.aten._batch_norm_with_update_functional(
        input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps
    )
